    num_groups = total_vals // group_size
    chunk_size = 8
    num_chunks = (total_vals + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size

    total_bytes_needed = num_chunks * 3
    if packed.size < total_bytes_needed:
        packed = np.concatenate([packed, np.zeros(total_bytes_needed - packed.size, dtype=np.uint8)])

    packed_chunks = packed[:num_chunks * 3].reshape(num_chunks, 3)
    b0 = packed_chunks[:, 0].astype(np.uint16)
    b1 = packed_chunks[:, 1].astype(np.uint16)
    b2 = packed_chunks[:, 2].astype(np.uint16)

    v0 = (b0 >> 5) & 7
    v1 = (b0 >> 2) & 7
    v2 = ((b0 & 3) << 1) | (b1 >> 7)
    v3 = (b1 >> 4) & 7
    v4 = (b1 >> 1) & 7
    v5 = ((b1 & 1) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)
    v6 = (b2 >> 3) & 7
    v7 = b2 & 7

    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7], axis=1).reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    flat_q = flat_q[:total_vals]

    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Reconstruct symmetric: subtract half, multiply by scale
    reconstructed = (groups_q - half) * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

    flat = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)

    pad = (group - (n % group)) % group
    if pad:
        flat_p = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_p = flat
    ng = flat_p.size // group
    blocks = flat_p.reshape(ng, group)
    
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 3 for 3-bit: [-3, 3]
    
    # Per-group scale based on max abs
    amax = np.max(np.abs(blocks), axis=1)  # (ng,)
    amax[amax == 0] = 1.0
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float16)
    
    # Quantize
    scales_f32 = scales.astype(np.float32)
    q = np.clip(np.round(blocks / scales_f32[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    
    # Pack two 3-bit values (range -3..3, shifted to 0..6) into one byte using 4 bits each
    # Actually for 3-bit signed: values in [-3,3], 7 levels, shift by 3 -> [0,6], fits in 3 bits
    # Pack into nibbles (4 bits each) since 3-bit packing is complex; use 4-bit per value but
    # store pairs in one byte (upper nibble + lower nibble)
    # This gives effective 4-bit storage same as seed_quant4 but with group scaling
    # To go below 4-bit: pack 3-bit values - 2 values per 6 bits, 8 values per 3 bytes
    
    # Shift to unsigned [0, 6]
    qu = (q + 3).astype(np.uint8)  # values in [0, 6], 3 bits each
    
    # Pack 8 values into 3 bytes (24 bits = 8 * 3 bits)
    total = qu.size
    # Pad to multiple of 8
    pad8 = (8 - (total % 8)) % 8
    if pad8:
        qu_p = np.concatenate([qu.ravel(), np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        qu_p = qu.ravel()
    
    # Reshape to (N, 8)
    nchunks = qu_p.size // 8
    chunks = qu_p.reshape(nchunks, 8)
    
    # Pack: byte0 = v0[2:0] | v1[2:0]<<3 | v2[1:0]<<6
    #       byte1 = v2[2]   | v3[2:0]<<1 | v4[2:0]<<4 | v5[1:0]<<7
    #       byte2 = v5[2]   | v6[2:0]<<1 | v7[2:0]<<4  (only 7 bits used of last)
    # Simpler: use numpy bit operations
    b0 = (chunks[:, 0] & 0x7) | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x7) << 3) | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 6)
    b1 = ((chunks[:, 2] >> 2) & 0x1) | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x7) << 1) | ((chunks[:, 4] & 0x7) << 4) | ((chunks[:, 5] & 0x1) << 7)
    b2 = ((chunks[:, 5] >> 1) & 0x3) | ((chunks[:, 6] & 0x7) << 2) | ((chunks[:, 7] & 0x7) << 5)
    
    packed = np.stack([b0, b1, b2], axis=1).ravel().astype(np.uint8)
    
    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scales": scales,
        "n": n,
        "ng": ng,
        "group": group,
        "pad": pad,
        "pad8": pad8,
        "total": total,
    }

    scales = payload["scales"].astype(np.float32)
    n = payload["n"]
    ng = payload["ng"]
    group = payload["group"]
    pad = payload["pad"]
    pad8 = payload["pad8"]
    total = payload["total"]
    
    nchunks = packed.size // 3
    b = packed.reshape(nchunks, 3).astype(np.uint8)
    
    v = np.zeros((nchunks, 8), dtype=np.uint8)
    v[:, 0] = b[:, 0] & 0x7
    v[:, 1] = (b[:, 0] >> 3) & 0x7
    v[:, 2] = ((b[:, 0] >> 6) & 0x3) | ((b[:, 1] & 0x1) << 2)
    v[:, 3] = (b[:, 1] >> 1) & 0x7
    v[:, 4] = (b[:, 1] >> 4) & 0x7
    v[:, 5] = ((b[:, 1] >> 7) & 0x1) | ((b[:, 2] & 0x3) << 1)
    v[:, 6] = (b[:, 2] >> 2) & 0x7
    v[:, 7] = (b[:, 2] >> 5) & 0x7
    
    qu_p = v.ravel()

    qu = qu_p[:total]
    # Convert back to signed
    q = qu.astype(np.int8) - 3
    
    # Reshape to (ng, group)
    q_blocks = q.reshape(ng, group)
    recon = q_blocks.astype(np.float32) * scales[:, None]
    
    flat_p = recon.ravel()
    # Remove group padding
    flat = flat_p[:n]
    return flat.reshape(shape)

def compress_tensor(w, bits=3, group_size=32):
    """
    Ultra-aggressive 3-bit group quantization with group_size=32.
    - Per-group symmetric quantization (only scale, no min) to reduce storage
    - 3 bits per weight packed tightly
    - Symmetric reduces overhead: store only scale (float16) vs min+scale
    - group_size=32 gives fewer scale values than group_size=16
    - Use float16 scales for extra compression
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size
    k = 1 << bits  # 8 levels
    qmax = (k // 2) - 1  # 3 for 3-bit symmetric: [-4..3] or use [-3..3] with 7 levels

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group symmetric: scale = max(abs) / qmax
    # Use 7 levels: -3..3 (symmetric, avoids asymmetry overhead)
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)  # (num_groups,)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    scale = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float32)

    # Quantize
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scale[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    # Shift to [0, 2*qmax] = [0, 6] so we can pack as uint8 with 3 bits
    q_shifted = (q + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # values in [0, 6], fits in 3 bits

    flat_q = q_shifted.reshape(-1)
    total_vals = flat_q.size

    # Pack 3 bits per value: 8 values -> 3 bytes
    chunk_size = 8
    num_chunks = (total_vals + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size
    pad2 = num_chunks * chunk_size - total_vals
    if pad2 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad2, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_chunks, chunk_size)

    b0 = (chunks[:, 0] << 5) | (chunks[:, 1] << 2) | (chunks[:, 2] >> 1)
    b1 = ((chunks[:, 2] & 1) << 7) | (chunks[:, 3] << 4) | (chunks[:, 4] << 1) | (chunks[:, 5] >> 2)
    b2 = ((chunks[:, 5] & 3) << 6) | (chunks[:, 6] << 3) | chunks[:, 7]

    total_bits = total_vals * bits
    total_bytes = (total_bits + 7) // 8

    packed = np.stack([b0, b1, b2], axis=1).reshape(-1)[:total_bytes]

    # Store scales as float16 to halve scale storage
    scale_f16 = scale.astype(np.float16)

def compress_tensor(w, bits=3, group_size=16):

    Each group of `group_size` elements shares a scale factor.
    Values are packed 2 per byte (nibble-style) to save space.
    With 3 bits: qmax=3, levels = -3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3
    Pack two 3-bit values into one byte (using 4 bits each, wasting 1 bit per value,
    but we pack tightly: store as int8 with values in [-3,3] then pack pairs).
    Actually we store packed: two values per byte using 4 bits each (fits 3-bit range).
    """
    original_shape = w.shape
    flat = w.flatten().astype(np.float32)
    n = len(flat)
    
    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        flat_padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_padded = flat
    
    n_padded = len(flat_padded)
    n_groups = n_padded // group_size
    
    groups = flat_padded.reshape(n_groups, group_size)
    
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 3 for bits=3
    
    # Per-group scale (symmetric)
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float16)
    
    # Quantize
    scales_f32 = scales.astype(np.float32)[:, np.newaxis]
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scales_f32), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    
    # Pack two int8 values (each in range [-7,7] fitting in 4 bits with offset) per byte
    # Shift values to [0, 2*qmax] = [0, 6] for 3-bit
    # Two values packed: high nibble and low nibble
    q_flat = q.flatten()
    q_shifted = (q_flat + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # now in [0, 6]
    
    # Pad to even length for packing
    if len(q_shifted) % 2 != 0:
        q_shifted = np.concatenate([q_shifted, np.array([0], dtype=np.uint8)])
    
    # Pack pairs: high nibble = first, low nibble = second
    q_high = q_shifted[0::2]
    q_low = q_shifted[1::2]

        "scales": scales,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "n_groups": np.int32(n_groups),

    Labels are packed tightly into bytes.

    if pad > 0:
        flat_pad = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_pad = flat
    
    n_padded = flat_pad.size
    n_groups = n_padded // group_size
    
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 3 bits -> 3
    levels = 2 * qmax + 1  # 7 levels: -3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3
    
    groups = flat_pad.reshape(n_groups, group_size)
    
    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float32)
    
    # Quantize: values in [-qmax, qmax], shift to [0, levels-1] for packing

    # 8 values * 3 bits = 24 bits = 3 bytes

    if pad8 > 0:
        q_flat_p = np.concatenate([q_flat, np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        q_flat_p = q_flat
    
    # Pack 8 values (3 bits each) into 3 bytes
    # Values are in [0,6], fit in 3 bits
    n_chunks = q_flat_p.size // 8
    chunks = q_flat_p.reshape(n_chunks, 8).astype(np.uint32)

                  | (chunks[:, 2] << 6)
                  | (chunks[:, 3] << 9)
                  | (chunks[:, 4] << 12)
                  | (chunks[:, 5] << 15)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 16,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=16):
    """
    2-bit group-wise symmetric quantization.
    2 bits per weight = ratio ~0.0625 before zlib, very low entropy.
    4 levels: {-3, -1, 1, 3} * scale  (odd-symmetric codebook, no zero)
    Actually use {-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5} * scale for uniform symmetric
    i.e. levels = [-3, -1, 1, 3] mapped to indices [0,1,2,3].
    Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each).
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group symmetric scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)

    # Codebook: 4 levels symmetric: -1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5 times scale
    # scale chosen so max level (1.5*scale) ~ amax => scale = amax / 1.5
    scale = (amax / 1.5).astype(np.float32)  # shape: (num_groups,)

    # Quantize: assign each value to nearest codebook entry
    # codebook entries: [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5] * scale[:,None]
    # index 0 -> -1.5*s, index 1 -> -0.5*s, index 2 -> 0.5*s, index 3 -> 1.5*s
    # boundary thresholds: -1.0*s, 0.0, 1.0*s
    s = scale[:, None]
    q = np.zeros((num_groups, group_size), dtype=np.uint8)
    q = np.where(groups < -1.0 * s, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(groups < 0.0,       np.uint8(1),
        np.where(groups < 1.0 * s,   np.uint8(2),
                                      np.uint8(3))))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)  # values in {0,1,2,3}

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float16),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    # Unpack 2-bit values
    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total]
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.float32)

    # Decode: index -> level
    # 0 -> -1.5, 1 -> -0.5, 2 -> 0.5, 3 -> 1.5
    levels = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)
    decoded_levels = levels[flat_q[:total].reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.int32)]
    reconstructed = decoded_levels * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

def compress_tensor(w, bits=3, group_size=16):
    """
    Group-wise symmetric quantization with 3 bits per weight.
    Weights are grouped into blocks of `group_size`, each with its own scale.
    3-bit indices are packed tightly (multiple indices per byte).
    This targets ~0.0625 ratio before overhead, beating seed_quant4's 0.0979.
    """
    flat = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = len(flat)
    
    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        flat_pad = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_pad = flat
    
    num_groups = len(flat_pad) // group_size
    groups = flat_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)
    
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 3 bits -> qmax=3
    
    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float32)
    
    # Quantize
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scales[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    
    # Pack 3-bit values: store as int8 for simplicity but pack pairs/triples
    # Use offset encoding: shift from [-3,3] to [0,6] (7 levels, fits in 3 bits)
    offset = qmax  # 3
    q_off = (q.reshape(-1) + offset).astype(np.uint8)  # values in [0, 6]
    
    # Pack 8 x 3-bit values into 3 bytes (24 bits)
    # Pad q_off to multiple of 8
    pad8 = (8 - (len(q_off) % 8)) % 8
    if pad8 > 0:
        q_off_p = np.concatenate([q_off, np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        q_off_p = q_off
    
    # Pack into bytes: 8 values * 3 bits = 24 bits = 3 bytes
    chunks = q_off_p.reshape(-1, 8)  # (M, 8)
    # bits: v0[2:0] v1[2:0] v2[2:0] ... v7[2:0] = 24 bits = 3 bytes
    b0 = (chunks[:, 0] & 0x7) | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x7) << 3) | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x2) << 5)
    b1 = ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x1) >> 0) | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x7) << 1) | ((chunks[:, 4] & 0x7) << 4) | ((chunks[:, 5] & 0x1) << 7)
    b2 = ((chunks[:, 5] & 0x6) >> 1) | ((chunks[:, 6] & 0x7) << 2) | ((chunks[:, 7] & 0x7) << 5)
    
    packed = np.stack([b0, b1, b2], axis=1).reshape(-1).astype(np.uint8)
    
    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scales": scales.astype(np.float16),  # use float16 for scales to save space
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "pad": np.int32(pad),
        "pad8": np.int32(pad8),
        "num_groups": np.int32(num_groups),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "bits": np.int32(bits),
        "qmax": np.int32(qmax),
        "offset": np.int32(offset),
    }

    packed = payload["packed"]
    scales = payload["scales"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    pad = int(payload["pad"])
    pad8 = int(payload["pad8"])
    num_groups = int(payload["num_groups"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    qmax = int(payload["qmax"])
    offset = int(payload["offset"])
    
    # Unpack 3-bit values from bytes
    # 3 bytes -> 8 values
    num_chunks = len(packed) // 3
    p = packed.reshape(num_chunks, 3)
    b0, b1, b2 = p[:, 0].astype(np.uint16), p[:, 1].astype(np.uint16), p[:, 2].astype(np.uint16)
    
    v0 = (b0 & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    v1 = ((b0 >> 3) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    v2 = (((b0 >> 5) & 0x6) | (b1 & 0x1)).astype(np.uint8)
    v3 = ((b1 >> 1) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    v4 = ((b1 >> 4) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    v5 = (((b1 >> 7) & 0x1) | ((b2 & 0x3) << 1)).astype(np.uint8)
    v6 = ((b2 >> 2) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    v7 = ((b2 >> 5) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    
    q_off = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7], axis=1).reshape(-1)
    
    # Remove pad8
    total_padded = num_groups * group_size
    q_off = q_off[:total_padded + pad]  # keep only what we need
    # Actually remove pad8 trailing elements
    if pad8 > 0:
        q_off = q_off[:-pad8]
    
    # Dequantize
    q = q_off.astype(np.int8) - offset  # back to [-qmax, qmax]
    
    groups = q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.float32)
    flat_pad = (groups * scales[:, None]).reshape(-1)
    
    # Remove padding
    if pad > 0:
        flat = flat_pad[:-pad]
    else:
        flat = flat_pad
    
    return flat[:n].reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 8,
    "codebook_size": 4,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=8, codebook_size=4):
    """
    1.5-bit effective quantization via ternary-like scheme with very small groups.
    
    Strategy: Use 2-bit quantization (4 levels) with group_size=8.
    The key insight: with group_size=8 and 2 bits, we get:
    - 2 bits/weight raw
    - But we use a TERNARY codebook {-1, 0, 1} * scale (3 levels)
      mapped to indices {0, 1, 2}, leaving index 3 unused
    - This means the packed bytes have lower entropy (biased distribution)
    - Additionally store scale as float16
    
    Actually, let's do true 2-bit with {-1, 0, 0, 1} collapse:
    Use only 3 distinct values, forcing lower entropy in the bitstream.
    
    Better approach: store indices in {0,1,2} (ternary) using 2 bits,
    but pack with a custom encoding that exploits the missing symbol.
    
    For maximum compression: use group_size=8 for better scale accuracy,
    and use TERNARY quantization (3 levels) packed into 2 bits each,
    so zlib can exploit the skewed symbol distribution (index 3 never used).
    
    Scale stored as float16 (2 bytes per group).
    For group_size=8: 2 bytes scale + 8*2/8 = 2 bytes indices = 4 bytes per 8 weights
    = 0.5 bytes/weight vs 4 bytes/weight fp32 => ratio 0.125 before zlib.
    Zlib will further compress since index 3 is never used.
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group symmetric scale based on mean absolute value
    # Use max for better reconstruction
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    scale = amax.astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)

    # Ternary quantization: {-1, 0, 1} * scale
    # threshold at 0.5 * scale
    thresh = 0.5 * scale_f32[:, None]
    q = np.zeros((num_groups, group_size), dtype=np.uint8)
    # index 0 -> -1 (negative, large magnitude)
    # index 1 -> 0  (near zero)
    # index 2 -> +1 (positive, large magnitude)
    # index 3 -> unused (helps zlib)
    q = np.where(groups < -thresh, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(groups > thresh,  np.uint8(2),
                                   np.uint8(1)))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)  # values in {0, 1, 2}

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.ones(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])  # pad with 1 (zero)
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    # Unpack 2-bit values
    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3

    diff = norm_groups[:, :, None] - codebook[None, None, :]  # (G, gs, 4)

            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    reconstructed = decoded * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

    Codebook: quantiles of N(0,1) at 4 equal-probability levels.
    Levels: [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5] * scale  (same as before but smaller groups).

    - group_size=8 gives better per-group quality with tiny scale overhead
    - Use fp16 scales (2 bytes per group of 8 = 2/8 = 0.25 bytes/weight for scales)
    - 2 bits/weight for quantized values
    - Total: 2/8 + 2/8 = 0.5 bits overhead + 2 bits = 2.25 bits/weight effective
    - But with zlib: low-entropy packed bytes compress further
    
    Actually let's also try to reduce entropy by using a better codebook.
    NF2 codebook for 2-bit: [-1.5732, -0.4307, 0.4307, 1.5732] (normal float quantiles)
    """

    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size

    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale: use RMS (better for normal distributions than max)
    # scale = sqrt(mean(x^2)) maps to normalized codebook
    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(groups ** 2, axis=1))
    rms = np.where(rms == 0, np.float32(1.0), rms)

    # NF2-like codebook optimized for normal distributions
    # 4 levels at quantile midpoints of N(0,1):
    # quantiles at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of N(0,1)
    # = [-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503] but scaled to match RMS
    # For N(0, rms): multiply by rms
    # Actually use codebook scaled so that RMS of codebook matches RMS of data

    # RMS of codebook = sqrt((1.5^2+0.5^2+0.5^2+1.5^2)/4) = sqrt(5/4) = ~1.118

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 8,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=8):
    """
    1.5-bit effective quantization via ternary quantization with dead-zone.
    Actually: 2-bit with group_size=8 but using a ternary-like approach:
    Use 3 levels {-1, 0, 1} * scale, packed as 2 bits (values 0,1,2; value 3 unused).
    This creates low-entropy packed data (many zeros for sparse networks) that zlib loves.
    
    Strategy: ternary quantization per group.
    Threshold = 0.5 * mean(|x|) per group -> values near zero mapped to 0.
    This produces high sparsity -> low entropy -> zlib compresses well.
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale: mean of absolute values (standard ternary)
    abs_groups = np.abs(groups)
    # threshold per group
    threshold = 0.5 * np.mean(abs_groups, axis=1)  # (num_groups,)
    
    # scale = mean of values that exceed threshold
    scale = np.zeros(num_groups, dtype=np.float32)
    for i in range(num_groups):
        mask = abs_groups[i] > threshold[i]
        if mask.any():
            scale[i] = np.mean(abs_groups[i][mask])
        else:
            scale[i] = np.max(abs_groups[i]) if np.max(abs_groups[i]) > 0 else 1.0

    # Quantize to ternary: -1, 0, +1
    # index: 0 -> -1, 1 -> 0, 2 -> +1, (3 unused)
    t = threshold[:, None]
    q = np.where(groups > t, np.uint8(2),
        np.where(groups < -t, np.uint8(0),
                               np.uint8(1)))  # 0=neg, 1=zero, 2=pos

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1).astype(np.uint8)

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each), values in {0,1,2}
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.ones(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])  # pad with 1 (zero)
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float16),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
    }

    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    # Unpack 2-bit values
    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total]
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.int8)

    # Decode: 0 -> -1, 1 -> 0, 2 -> +1
    # ternary values
    ternary = (groups_q.astype(np.float32) - 1.0)  # {0,1,2} -> {-1,0,1}
    reconstructed = ternary * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]

    else:

    num_groups = groups.shape[0]

    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float16)

    scales_f32 = scales.astype(np.float32)[:, None]
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scales_f32), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)

    # Offset to unsigned: [0, 2*qmax]

    else:

    reconstructed = groups * scales[:, None]

    flat_out = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_out.astype(np.float32).reshape(shape)

def compress_tensor(w, bits=3, group_size=16):

        flat_padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_padded = flat

    num_groups = groups.shape[0]

    # qmax = 3 for 3-bit signed (range [-3..3])
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 3 for 3-bit

    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float16)

    # Quantize
    scales_f32 = scales.astype(np.float32)[:, None]
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scales_f32), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)

    # Pack 3-bit values: shift to [0, 6], then pack into bytes
    # 3 bits per value, pack 8 values into 3 bytes (24 bits)
    # For simplicity, pack as many 3-bit values as possible into uint8 stream
    # Strategy: treat the flat array as a bitstream
    q_shifted = (q.reshape(-1) + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # [0, 6], needs 3 bits each
    total_vals = q_shifted.size

        q_padded = np.concatenate([q_shifted, np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        q_padded = q_shifted

    chunks = q_padded.reshape(num_chunks, 8)

    # bits layout: [v0:3][v1:3][v2:3][v3:3][v4:3][v5:3][v6:3][v7:3]
    # = 24 bits = 3 bytes

    byte2 = (((chunks[:, 5] >> 1) & 0x3) | ((chunks[:, 6] & 0x7) << 2) | ((chunks[:, 7] & 0x7) << 5)).astype(np.uint8)

    packed = np.empty(num_chunks * 3, dtype=np.uint8)
    packed[0::3] = byte0
    packed[1::3] = byte1
    packed[2::3] = byte2

    chunks[:, 6] = ((byte2 >> 2) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)
    chunks[:, 7] = ((byte2 >> 5) & 0x7).astype(np.uint8)

    q = q_shifted.astype(np.int16) - qmax  # back to [-qmax, qmax]

    groups = q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.float32)
    reconstructed = groups * scales[:, None]
    flat = reconstructed.reshape(-1)

    if pad > 0:
        flat = flat[:-pad]

    return flat.astype(np.float32).reshape(shape)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 4,
    "group_size": 16,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=4, group_size=16):
    """
    Group-wise quantization with shared per-group scale.
    Each group of `group_size` elements shares a scale factor.
    Values are packed two 4-bit values per byte.
    This achieves ~0.5 bits/param overhead for scales (float16 per group)
    plus 4 bits/param for quantized values = ~0.5625 bytes/param.
    For float32 baseline (4 bytes/param), ratio ~ 0.14 before zlib.
    With zlib on low-entropy int4 data, expect much lower effective ratio.
    """
    flat = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = flat.size
    
    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        padded = flat
    
    num_groups = padded.size // group_size
    groups = padded.reshape(num_groups, group_size)
    
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 7 for 4-bit
    
    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float16)
    
    # Quantize
    scale_f32 = scales.astype(np.float32)[:, np.newaxis]
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scale_f32), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    
    # Pack two 4-bit values per byte (offset by qmax to make unsigned 0..14)
    q_unsigned = (q + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # now 0..14, fits in 4 bits
    q_flat = q_unsigned.reshape(-1)
    
    # Pack pairs: low nibble = even index, high nibble = odd index
    even = q_flat[0::2]
    odd = q_flat[1::2]
    packed = (even & 0x0F) | ((odd & 0x0F) << 4)
    
    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scales": scales,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "pad": np.int32(pad),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "qmax": np.int32(qmax),
    }

def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scales = payload["scales"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    pad = int(payload["pad"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    qmax = int(payload["qmax"])
    
    # Unpack nibbles
    total = (n + pad)
    even = (packed & 0x0F).astype(np.uint8)
    odd = ((packed >> 4) & 0x0F).astype(np.uint8)
    q_unsigned = np.empty(len(even) + len(odd), dtype=np.uint8)
    q_unsigned[0::2] = even
    q_unsigned[1::2] = odd
    q_unsigned = q_unsigned[:total]
    
    q = q_unsigned.astype(np.int8) - qmax  # back to signed
    
    num_groups = total // group_size
    groups = q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.float32)
    reconstructed = groups * scales[:, np.newaxis]
    
    flat = reconstructed.reshape(-1)
    if pad > 0:
        flat = flat[:n]
    
    return flat.reshape(shape)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 8,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=8):
    """
    2-bit group-wise quantization with group_size=8 for better quality,
    using a non-uniform codebook trained per-group (Lloyd-style, 2 iterations).
    Codebook: 4 entries per group learned from data.
    Pack 4x 2-bit values per byte.
    Scales stored as float16.
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    num_levels = 1 << bits  # 4

    # Per-group: use symmetric uniform quantization but with NF4-inspired non-uniform levels
    # Use fixed relative levels optimized for Gaussian weights:
    # For 2-bit: use quantiles of N(0,1): approx [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5] * sigma
    # But we'll do a fast 2-iter Lloyd per group to adapt to actual distribution

    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)

    # Initial codebook: uniform symmetric over [-amax, amax]
    # levels: -1.5/1.5 * scale where scale = amax/1.5
    # Instead use 4 quantile-based fixed levels for Gaussian:
    # roughly at -1.224, -0.3, 0.3, 1.224 (quartile boundaries of std normal)
    fixed_levels = np.array([-1.224, -0.3, 0.3, 1.224], dtype=np.float32)

    # Scale fixed levels to match group magnitude
    # scale = amax / 1.224
    scale = (amax / 1.224).astype(np.float32)  # (num_groups,)

    # Quantize each group
    scaled_levels = scale[:, None] * fixed_levels[None, :]  # (num_groups, 4)

    # For each group element, find nearest level
    # groups: (num_groups, group_size), scaled_levels: (num_groups, 4)
    # Expand for broadcasting: (num_groups, group_size, 1) vs (num_groups, 1, 4)
    diffs = np.abs(groups[:, :, None] - scaled_levels[:, None, :])  # (num_groups, group_size, 4)
    q = np.argmin(diffs, axis=2).astype(np.uint8)  # (num_groups, group_size)

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)  # values in {0,1,2,3}

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float16),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    # Unpack 2-bit values
    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total]
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size).astype(np.int32)

    # Decode using fixed levels
    fixed_levels = np.array([-1.224, -0.3, 0.3, 1.224], dtype=np.float32)
    decoded_levels = fixed_levels[groups_q]  # (num_groups, group_size)
    reconstructed = decoded_levels * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 32,
    "codebook_type": 1,  # 1 = NF2 (normal float), 0 = uniform symmetric
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=32, codebook_type=1):
    """
    1.5-bit effective quantization via ternary + sparsity mask approach.
    
    Strategy: Use 2-bit quantization but with group_size=32 to amortize scale overhead,
    and use a better codebook (normal-float 2) aligned with weight distributions.
    
    NF2 codebook: designed for normally distributed weights.
    4 values chosen such that each interval has equal probability under N(0,1):
    quantiles at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of N(0,1)
    => {-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503}
    
    This gives lower reconstruction error for normal-ish weights vs uniform codebook.
    Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each).
    """
    # NF2 codebook: quantiles of N(0,1) at 1/8, 3/8, 5/8, 7/8
    # These are: ppf(0.125), ppf(0.375), ppf(0.625), ppf(0.875)
    if codebook_type == 1:
        # Normal quantile codebook (better for normally distributed weights)
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        # Uniform symmetric fallback
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale: align codebook to weight range
    # scale = amax / CB_max so that CB * scale covers [-amax, amax]
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    cb_max = CB[-1]  # 1.1503 or 1.5
    scale = (amax / cb_max).astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)[:, None]

    # Quantize each group: find nearest codebook entry
    # Boundaries at midpoints of codebook entries
    # CB = [c0, c1, c2, c3], boundaries at (c0+c1)/2, (c1+c2)/2, (c2+c3)/2
    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2  # ~ -0.7345
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2  # ~ 0.0
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2  # ~ 0.7345

    # Normalize groups by scale
    g_norm = groups / scale_f32

    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale,          # float16 scales, shape (num_groups,)
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "codebook_type": np.int32(codebook_type),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    codebook_type = int(payload["codebook_type"])

    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    # Unpack 2-bit values
    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total].astype(np.int32)
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Decode via codebook
    decoded = CB[groups_q] * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = decoded.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 3,
    "group_size": 32,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=3, group_size=32):
    """
    Aggressive 3-bit group quantization with larger groups (32) to reduce scale overhead.
    Uses symmetric quantization (just scale, no offset) to halve the per-group metadata,
    and packs 3-bit values tightly. Symmetric is nearly as good as asymmetric for weights
    that are roughly zero-centered.
    
    Storage per weight:
      - 3 bits quantized value (packed)
      - 1 float32 scale per group_size=32 weights => 4/32 = 0.125 bytes/weight
      - Total: 3/8 + 4/32 = 0.375 + 0.125 = 0.5 bytes/weight
      - vs fp32: 4 bytes/weight => ratio ~0.125 before zlib
      - With zlib on the low-entropy packed data, expect well below 0.089
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size
    k = 1 << bits  # 8 levels for 3-bit
    qmax = (k // 2) - 1  # 3 for 3-bit symmetric: levels -3..3 (7 levels, center at 0)
    # Use 7 levels: -3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3 stored as uint8 0..6

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group symmetric scale: max(abs) / qmax
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    scale = amax / float(qmax)  # shape: (num_groups,)

    # Quantize symmetrically
    q = np.clip(np.round(groups / scale[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    # Shift to unsigned: 0..6
    q_u = (q + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # values in [0, 2*qmax] = [0, 6]

    # Pack 3-bit values: 8 values -> 3 bytes (exactly 24 bits)
    flat_q = q_u.reshape(-1)
    total_vals = flat_q.size

    chunk_size = 8
    num_chunks = (total_vals + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size
    pad2 = num_chunks * chunk_size - total_vals
    if pad2 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad2, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_chunks, chunk_size)

    # Pack 8 x 3-bit values into 3 bytes
    b0 = (chunks[:, 0] << 5) | (chunks[:, 1] << 2) | (chunks[:, 2] >> 1)
    b1 = ((chunks[:, 2] & 1) << 7) | (chunks[:, 3] << 4) | (chunks[:, 4] << 1) | (chunks[:, 5] >> 2)
    b2 = ((chunks[:, 5] & 3) << 6) | (chunks[:, 6] << 3) | chunks[:, 7]

    total_bits = total_vals * bits
    total_bytes = (total_bits + 7) // 8

    packed = np.stack([b0, b1, b2], axis=1).reshape(-1)[:total_bytes]

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float32),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "pad": np.int32(pad),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "qmax": np.int8(qmax),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"]
    n = int(payload["n"])
    pad = int(payload["pad"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    qmax = int(payload["qmax"])

    pad2_total = n + pad
    num_groups = pad2_total // group_size
    total_vals = pad2_total

    chunk_size = 8
    num_chunks = (total_vals + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size

    total_bytes_needed = num_chunks * 3
    if packed.size < total_bytes_needed:
        packed = np.concatenate([packed, np.zeros(total_bytes_needed - packed.size, dtype=np.uint8)])

    packed_chunks = packed[:num_chunks * 3].reshape(num_chunks, 3)
    b0 = packed_chunks[:, 0].astype(np.uint16)
    b1 = packed_chunks[:, 1].astype(np.uint16)
    b2 = packed_chunks[:, 2].astype(np.uint16)

    v0 = (b0 >> 5) & 7
    v1 = (b0 >> 2) & 7
    v2 = ((b0 & 3) << 1) | (b1 >> 7)
    v3 = (b1 >> 4) & 7
    v4 = (b1 >> 1) & 7
    v5 = ((b1 & 1) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)
    v6 = (b2 >> 3) & 7
    v7 = b2 & 7

    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7], axis=1).reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    flat_q = flat_q[:total_vals]

    # Unshift: back to signed
    flat_q_signed = flat_q - float(qmax)

    groups_q = flat_q_signed.reshape(num_groups, group_size)
    reconstructed = groups_q * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

    Each group of `group_size` elements shares a scale.
    The 3-bit indices are packed into bytes (8 values -> 3 bytes).
    This gives ~3/32 = 0.09375 raw ratio, but with group scales overhead
    and packing it comes in well under seed_quant4's 0.0979.
    
    Actually at 3 bits packed + group scales, we get:
    - indices: n * 3 / 8 bytes
    - scales: (n / group_size) * 4 bytes
    
    For large tensors the scale overhead is small.
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size
    k = 1 << bits  # 8 levels
    qmax = (k // 2) - 1  # 3 for 3-bit signed: range [-4..3] but use symmetric [-3..3]
    
    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        xp = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        xp = x
    
    xp = xp.reshape(-1, group_size)
    num_groups = xp.shape[0]
    
    # Per-group symmetric quantization
    amax = np.max(np.abs(xp), axis=1)  # (num_groups,)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax).astype(np.float32)
    scale = amax / qmax  # (num_groups,)
    
    # Quantize: levels from -qmax to qmax (symmetric, 2*qmax+1=7 levels for 3-bit)
    # We'll use range [-3, 3] encoded as 0-6, stored in 3 bits
    q = np.clip(np.round(xp / scale[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)
    # Encode as unsigned: shift by qmax so range is [0, 2*qmax] = [0, 6]
    qu = (q + qmax).astype(np.uint8)  # values 0..6, fits in 3 bits
    
    # Pack 3-bit values into bytes: 8 values per 3 bytes
    flat = qu.reshape(-1)
    total = flat.size  # multiple of group_size
    
    # Pack 8 values into 3 bytes
    # Pad to multiple of 8
    pad8 = (8 - (total % 8)) % 8
    if pad8 > 0:
        flat = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    
    flat = flat.reshape(-1, 8)
    # Each group of 8 values packed into 3 bytes (24 bits)
    # v0 v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7, each 3 bits

    b2 = ((flat[:, 5] & 3) << 6) | (flat[:, 6] << 3) | flat[:, 7]
    
    packed = np.stack([b0, b1, b2], axis=1).reshape(-1).astype(np.uint8)
    
    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float32),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "pad": np.int32(pad),
        "pad8": np.int32(pad8),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "qmax": np.int32(qmax),
    }

    scale = payload["scale"]
    n = int(payload["n"])
    pad = int(payload["pad"])
    pad8 = int(payload["pad8"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    qmax = int(payload["qmax"])

    b1 = groups[:, 1].astype(np.uint16)

    v3 = (b1 >> 4) & 7
    v4 = (b1 >> 1) & 7

    v6 = (b2 >> 3) & 7

    else:
        x_pad = x

    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    g_min = groups.min(axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    g_max = groups.max(axis=1).astype(np.float32)

    g_range = g_max - g_min
    g_range = np.where(g_range == 0, np.float32(1.0), g_range)

    scale = (g_range / (k - 1)).astype(np.float32)

    # Quantize each group

    q = np.clip(np.round(normalized), 0, k - 1).astype(np.uint8)

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)
    total_vals = flat_q.size

    pad2 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4

    else:

    ).astype(np.uint8)

    "rank": 4,
    "bits": 4,
    "group_size": 16,
    "svd_scale_bits": 8,
}

def compress_tensor(w, rank=4, bits=4, group_size=16, svd_scale_bits=8):
    """
    Low-rank + quantized residual compression:
    1. Compute truncated SVD of the weight matrix (reshaped to 2D)
    2. Quantize U, S, V components aggressively
    3. Quantize the residual with group-wise 4-bit quantization
    4. Store everything packed for minimal entropy
    """
    original_shape = w.shape
    
    # Reshape to 2D
    if w.ndim == 1:
        mat = w.reshape(1, -1)
    elif w.ndim == 2:
        mat = w
    else:
        mat = w.reshape(w.shape[0], -1)
    
    m, n = mat.shape
    effective_rank = min(rank, m, n)
    
    qmax4 = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1  # 7
    qmax8 = (1 << (svd_scale_bits - 1)) - 1  # 127
    
    # SVD
    try:
        U, s, Vt = np.linalg.svd(mat, full_matrices=False)
        U = U[:, :effective_rank]
        s = s[:effective_rank]
        Vt = Vt[:effective_rank, :]
    except Exception:
        effective_rank = 0
        U = np.zeros((m, 0), dtype=np.float32)
        s = np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float32)
        Vt = np.zeros((0, n), dtype=np.float32)
    
    # Reconstruct low-rank approximation
    if effective_rank > 0:
        low_rank = (U * s[np.newaxis, :]) @ Vt
    else:
        low_rank = np.zeros_like(mat)
    
    # Residual
    residual = mat - low_rank
    
    # Quantize singular values (8-bit)
    if effective_rank > 0:
        s_amax = float(np.max(np.abs(s))) or 1.0
        s_scale = s_amax / qmax8
        s_q = np.clip(np.round(s / s_scale), -qmax8, qmax8).astype(np.int8)
        
        # Quantize U columns (8-bit per column scale)
        U_scales = np.max(np.abs(U), axis=0)
        U_scales = np.where(U_scales == 0, 1.0, U_scales)
        U_q = np.clip(np.round(U / (U_scales[np.newaxis, :] / qmax8)), -qmax8, qmax8).astype(np.int8)
        U_scales_q = U_scales.astype(np.float16)
        
        # Quantize Vt rows (8-bit per row scale)
        Vt_scales = np.max(np.abs(Vt), axis=1)
        Vt_scales = np.where(Vt_scales == 0, 1.0, Vt_scales)
        Vt_q = np.clip(np.round(Vt / (Vt_scales[:, np.newaxis] / qmax8)), -qmax8, qmax8).astype(np.int8)
        Vt_scales_q = Vt_scales.astype(np.float16)
    else:
        s_scale = np.float32(1.0)
        s_q = np.zeros(0, dtype=np.int8)
        U_q = np.zeros((m, 0), dtype=np.int8)
        U_scales_q = np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float16)
        Vt_q = np.zeros((0, n), dtype=np.int8)
        Vt_scales_q = np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float16)
    
    # Group-wise 4-bit quantization of residual
    flat = residual.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    nres = flat.size
    
    pad = (group_size - (nres % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        padded = flat
    
    num_groups = padded.size // group_size
    groups = padded.reshape(num_groups, group_size)
    
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, 1.0, amax)
    res_scales = (amax / qmax4).astype(np.float16)
    
    scale_f32 = res_scales.astype(np.float32)[:, np.newaxis]
    q_res = np.clip(np.round(groups / scale_f32), -qmax4, qmax4).astype(np.int8)

    even = q_unsigned[0::2]
    odd = q_unsigned[1::2] if len(q_unsigned) > 1 else np.zeros(len(even), dtype=np.uint8)
    # handle odd length
    if len(q_unsigned) % 2 == 1:
        odd = np.concatenate([q_unsigned[1::2], np.zeros(1, dtype=np.uint8)])

        "s_q": s_q,
        "s_scale": np.float32(s_scale),
        "U_q": U_q,
        "U_scales": U_scales_q,
        "Vt_q": Vt_q,
        "Vt_scales": Vt_scales_q,

    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 16,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=16):
    """
    2-bit group-wise quantization with asymmetric per-group min/max.
    2 bits per weight = 0.25 bytes/param raw, ~0.0625 ratio before overhead.
    Groups share float16 min + float16 scale = 4 bytes per group_size=16 weights.
    Total overhead: 4/(16*4) = 0.0625 of fp32 size for scales.
    Packed: 4 values per byte.
    Expected effective ratio well below 0.072 after zlib.
    """
    flat = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = flat.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        padded = flat

    num_groups = padded.size // group_size
    groups = padded.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    levels = (1 << bits)  # 4 levels for 2-bit

    # Per-group asymmetric quantization
    g_min = groups.min(axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    g_max = groups.max(axis=1).astype(np.float32)

    g_range = g_max - g_min
    g_range = np.where(g_range == 0, np.float32(1.0), g_range)

    scale = (g_range / (levels - 1)).astype(np.float32)

    # Quantize to [0, levels-1]
    normalized = (groups - g_min[:, None]) / scale[:, None]
    q = np.clip(np.round(normalized), 0, levels - 1).astype(np.uint8)

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)
    total_vals = flat_q.size

    # Pad to multiple of 4
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)

    packed = (
        (chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
        | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
        | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
        | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)
    ).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "g_min": g_min.astype(np.float16),
        "scale": scale.astype(np.float16),
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "pad": np.int32(pad),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "bits": np.int32(bits),

    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    pad = int(payload["pad"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    num_groups = total_vals // group_size

    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3).astype(np.float32)

    v2 = ((b >> 4) & 0x3).astype(np.float32)
    v3 = ((b >> 6) & 0x3).astype(np.float32)

    flat_q[1::4] = v1
    flat_q[2::4] = v2

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=16, codebook_type=1, top_k_frac=0.12):
    """
    Ultra-aggressive compression: 2-bit grouped quantization (NF2 codebook, group_size=16)
    + sparse float16 residual correction for the largest-error elements.
    
    At group_size=16 with 2 bits: 2/16 = 0.125 bits overhead per weight for scales (float16).
    Plus ~12% sparse residual in float16 (index + value).
    
    The sparse residual dramatically improves reconstruction quality, allowing recovery
    even at this extreme compression level.
    
    Effective bits: 2 + 0.125*16 + 12%*32 ≈ minimal but recoverable.
    """
    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    cb_max = CB[-1]
    scale = (amax / cb_max).astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)[:, None]

    # Quantization boundaries
    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2

    g_norm = groups / scale_f32
    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    # Reconstruction from quantization (for residual computation)
    recon_norm = CB[q.astype(np.int32)]
    recon_groups = recon_norm * scale_f32
    recon_flat = recon_groups.reshape(-1)[:n]

    residual = x - recon_flat

    # Select top-k residuals by absolute value
    k = max(1, int(math.ceil(top_k_frac * n)))
    abs_res = np.abs(residual)
    # Use argpartition for efficiency

            recon_lr = U_r.astype(np.float32) @ V_r.astype(np.float32)
            residual = mat - recon_lr
        else:
            residual = mat
    else:
        residual = mat

    # Now quantize the residual with 2-bit NF2 group quantization
    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = residual.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    cb_max = CB[-1]
    scale = (amax / cb_max).astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)[:, None]

    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2

    g_norm = groups / scale_f32

    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)

    pad4 = (4 - (flat_q.size % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "codebook_type": np.int32(codebook_type),
        "U": U_h,
        "V": V_h,
        "rows": np.int32(rows),
        "cols": np.int32(cols),
        "rank": np.int32(rank),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)

    codebook_type = int(payload["codebook_type"])

    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total].astype(np.int32)
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    decoded = CB[groups_q] * scale[:, None]
    flat_r = decoded.reshape(-1)[:n]
    residual_mat = flat_r.reshape(rows, cols).astype(np.float32)

    if rank > 0 and U_h.shape[1] > 0:
        lr = U_h.astype(np.float32) @ V_h.astype(np.float32)
        mat = lr + residual_mat
    else:

    return mat.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 16,
    "codebook_type": 1,
    "top_k_frac": 0.04,   # fraction of large-magnitude residuals stored as sparse correction
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=16, codebook_type=1, top_k_frac=0.04):
    """
    2-bit NF2 grouped quantization + sparse residual correction.
    
    Key ideas to beat ratio=0.0528:
    1. Smaller group_size=16 → better per-group scale fit → lower quantization error
       → residuals are smaller → sparse correction needs fewer entries
    2. Sparse residual: store only the top-k largest-magnitude reconstruction errors
       using int16 indices + float16 values. This patches the worst outliers cheaply.
    3. Overall: quantized base uses ~2 bits/weight + tiny overhead, sparse patch adds
       ~(top_k_frac * 16bits index + 16bits value) per corrected weight.
    
    At group_size=16, scale overhead = 1 float16 per 16 weights = 1/16 fp16 = 1 byte/weight
    But with zlib, repetitive near-zero residuals compress very well.
    """
    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    cb_max = CB[-1]
    scale = (amax / cb_max).astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)[:, None]

    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2

    g_norm = groups / scale_f32

    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    # Reconstruct quantized values to compute residuals
    decoded_groups = CB[q.astype(np.int32)] * scale_f32
    decoded_flat = decoded_groups.reshape(-1)[:n]
    residuals = x - decoded_flat

    # Sparse residual correction: store top-k by magnitude
    k = max(0, int(round(top_k_frac * n)))
    if k > 0 and n > 0:
        abs_res = np.abs(residuals)
        # Use argpartition for efficiency
        if k < n:
            top_idx = np.argpartition(abs_res, n - k)[n - k:]
        else:
            top_idx = np.arange(n)
        # Sort for better entropy / zlib compression
        top_idx = np.sort(top_idx).astype(np.int32)
        top_vals = residuals[top_idx].astype(np.float16)
    else:
        top_idx = np.array([], dtype=np.int32)
        top_vals = np.array([], dtype=np.float16)

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)

    # Pack 4 values per byte (2 bits each)
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "codebook_type": np.int32(codebook_type),
        "sp_idx": top_idx,
        "sp_vals": top_vals,
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    codebook_type = int(payload["codebook_type"])
    sp_idx = payload["sp_idx"]
    sp_vals = payload["sp_vals"].astype(np.float32)

    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total].astype(np.int32)
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    decoded = CB[groups_q] * scale[:, None]
    flat_r = decoded.reshape(-1)[:n]

    # Apply sparse residual correction
    if sp_idx.size > 0:
        flat_r = flat_r.copy()
        flat_r[sp_idx] += sp_vals

    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "group_size": 256,
    "bits": 2,
    "scale_bits": 6,
}

def compress_tensor(w, group_size=256, bits=2, scale_bits=6):
    """
    Ultra-aggressive 2-bit quantization with:
    - Large group_size=256 to minimize scale overhead
    - Scales stored as 6-bit (64 levels) quantized to uint8 but value-limited
    - NF2 codebook tuned for normal distributions
    - Single global scale + per-group 6-bit relative scale
    
    Effective bits/param:
    - 2 bits/param for codes
    - 6 bits / 256 = 0.0234 bits/param for scales
    - Total ~2.023 bits/param
    - Ratio = 2.023/32 = 0.0632... but zlib compresses further
    
    To push below 0.0528, we need zlib to compress well.
    Strategy: use a 1-bit sign + 1 magnitude bit scheme = effectively binary
    with per-group scale, giving near-ternary quality.
    
    Actually: use TRUE 1-bit (binary) quantization with group_size=256.
    - 1 bit/param for codes  
    - 16 bits / 256 = 0.0625 bits/param for fp16 scale
    - Total ~1.0625 bits/param
    - Ratio = 1.0625/32 = 0.0332 < 0.0528 ✓
    
    Binary: each weight -> sign(w) * scale, scale = mean(|w|) in group
    This is XNOR-Net style. Quality might be enough for retrain recovery.
    """
    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale = mean absolute value (optimal for binary quantization)
    scales = np.mean(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    scales = np.where(scales == 0, np.float32(1.0), scales)

    # Binary quantization: sign
    signs = np.sign(groups)
    signs = np.where(signs == 0, np.float32(1.0), signs)
    # signs is -1 or +1, encode as 0/1 bit
    bits_arr = ((signs + 1) / 2).astype(np.uint8)  # 0 or 1

    flat_bits = bits_arr.reshape(-1)  # n+pad bits

    # Pack 8 bits per byte
    total_bits = flat_bits.size
    pad8 = (8 - (total_bits % 8)) % 8
    if pad8 > 0:
        flat_bits_p = np.concatenate([flat_bits, np.zeros(pad8, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_bits_p = flat_bits

    num_bytes = flat_bits_p.size // 8
    # Pack using reshape and bit shifting
    bits_mat = flat_bits_p.reshape(num_bytes, 8).astype(np.uint8)
    packed = np.zeros(num_bytes, dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(8):
        packed |= (bits_mat[:, i] << i)

    # Store scales as float16 to save space
    scales_f16 = scales.astype(np.float16)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scales": scales_f16,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scales_f16 = payload["scales"]
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])

    scales = scales_f16.astype(np.float32)

    # Unpack bits
    num_bytes = packed.size
    total_bits = num_bytes * 8
    bits_mat = np.zeros((num_bytes, 8), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(8):
        bits_mat[:, i] = (packed >> i) & 1

    flat_bits = bits_mat.reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad

    flat_bits = flat_bits[:total].astype(np.float32)
    # Convert 0/1 back to -1/+1
    signs = flat_bits * 2.0 - 1.0

    num_groups = total // group_size
    groups = signs.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Reconstruct: multiply by per-group scale
    reconstructed = groups * scales[:, None]

    flat_r = reconstructed.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "rank": 3,          # low-rank components to keep
    "bits": 4,          # bits for quantizing residual
    "group_size": 16,   # group size for grouped quantization of residual
}

def compress_tensor(w, rank=3, bits=4, group_size=16):
    shape = w.shape
    w_2d = w.reshape(shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32)
    rows, cols = w_2d.shape

    # Clamp rank to valid range
    actual_rank = min(rank, rows, cols)

    if actual_rank > 0 and rows > 1 and cols > 1:
        # SVD-based low-rank approximation
        U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(w_2d, full_matrices=False)
        U_r = U[:, :actual_rank]
        S_r = S[:actual_rank]
        Vt_r = Vt[:actual_rank, :]

        # Absorb S into U for reconstruction: w_approx = U_r @ np.diag(S_r) @ Vt_r
        US_r = (U_r * S_r).astype(np.float32)

        # Residual
        w_approx = US_r @ Vt_r
        residual = (w_2d - w_approx).astype(np.float32)
    else:
        actual_rank = 0
        US_r = np.zeros((rows, 0), dtype=np.float32)
        Vt_r = np.zeros((0, cols), dtype=np.float32)
        residual = w_2d.astype(np.float32)

    # Quantize residual with grouped quantization
    flat = residual.reshape(-1)
    n = len(flat)
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1

    # Pad to multiple of group_size
    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        flat_padded = np.concatenate([flat, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        flat_padded = flat

    num_groups = len(flat_padded) // group_size
    grouped = flat_padded.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale
    amax = np.max(np.abs(grouped), axis=1)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax).astype(np.float32)
    scales = (amax / qmax).astype(np.float32)

    # Quantize
    q = np.clip(np.round(grouped / scales[:, None]), -qmax, qmax).astype(np.int8)

    # Pack 4-bit values into nibbles if bits==4
    if bits == 4:
        q_flat = q.reshape(-1)
        # values are in [-7, 7], shift to [0, 15] for packing
        q_shifted = (q_flat + 8).astype(np.uint8)  # [0,15]
        # pack pairs
        if len(q_shifted) % 2 != 0:
            q_shifted = np.concatenate([q_shifted, np.array([8], dtype=np.uint8)])
        packed = (q_shifted[0::2] | (q_shifted[1::2] << 4)).astype(np.uint8)
        payload = {
            "packed": packed,
            "scales": scales,
            "US_r": US_r if actual_rank > 0 else None,
            "Vt_r": Vt_r if actual_rank > 0 else None,
            "actual_rank": actual_rank,
            "rows": rows,
            "cols": cols,
            "n_orig": n,
            "bits": np.int8(bits),
            "group_size": np.int8(group_size),
        }
    else:
        payload = {
            "q": q,
            "scales": scales,
            "US_r": US_r if actual_rank > 0 else None,
            "Vt_r": Vt_r if actual_rank > 0 else None,
            "actual_rank": actual_rank,
            "rows": rows,
            "cols": cols,
            "n_orig": n,
            "bits": np.int8(bits),
            "group_size": np.int8(group_size),
        }
    return payload


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    bits = int(payload["bits"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    actual_rank = int(payload["actual_rank"])
    rows = int(payload["rows"])
    cols = int(payload["cols"])
    n_orig = int(payload["n_orig"])
    scales = payload["scales"]
    qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1

    if bits == 4:
        packed = payload["packed"]
        # unpack nibbles
        lo = (packed & 0x0F).astype(np.int8)
        hi = ((packed >> 4) & 0x0F).astype(np.int8)
        q_shifted = np.empty(len(packed) * 2, dtype=np.uint8)
        q_shifted[0::2] = lo
        q_shifted[1::2] = hi
        q_flat = (q_shifted.astype(np.int8) - 8)
        num_groups = len(scales)
        total_padded = num_groups * group_size
        q_flat = q_flat[:total_padded]
        grouped = q_flat.reshape(num_groups, group_size)
    else:
        grouped = payload["q"]

    # Dequantize
    residual_padded = (grouped.astype(np.float32) * scales[:, None]).reshape(-1)
    residual_flat = residual_padded[:n_orig]
    residual = residual_flat.reshape(rows, cols)

    # Add low-rank approximation
    if actual_rank > 0 and payload["US_r"] is not None:
        US_r = payload["US_r"].astype(np.float32)
        Vt_r = payload["Vt_r"].astype(np.float32)
        w_approx = US_r @ Vt_r
        w_2d = w_approx + residual
    else:
        w_2d = residual

    return w_2d.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 256,
    "scale_bits": 6,
    "codebook_type": 1,
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=256, scale_bits=6, codebook_type=1):
    """
    Ultra-aggressive 2-bit NF2 quantization with very large groups and
    heavily quantized scales stored as 6-bit values.
    
    Bit budget per weight:
    - 2 bits for code
    - 6 bits / 256 = 0.0234 bits for scale
    - Total: ~2.023 bits/param
    - Ratio: 2.023/32 = 0.0632 ... but with zlib compression on low-entropy
      packed data this should compress further.
    
    To get below 0.0528, we need the zlib-compressed output to be tiny.
    Key: use very large group_size (256+) so scale overhead is minimal,
    and use only 6 bits for scales (64 levels) to reduce entropy.
    
    Also: store scales delta-encoded + sorted to maximize zlib compression.
    """
    if codebook_type == 1:
        # NF2: optimal normal-distribution quantization centroids
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1e-8), amax)
    cb_max = CB[-1]

    # Global scale from max amax
    global_scale = float(np.max(amax))
    if global_scale == 0:
        global_scale = 1.0

    # Quantize scales to scale_bits (e.g. 6 bits = 64 levels)
    scale_levels = (1 << scale_bits) - 1  # 63
    norm_scales = amax / global_scale  # in (0, 1]
    # Use log-scale quantization for better fidelity on small scales
    # But actually linear is fine since weights ~ normal and amax ~ folded normal
    scale_q = np.clip(np.round(norm_scales * scale_levels), 1, scale_levels).astype(np.uint8)
    scale_recon = (scale_q.astype(np.float32) / scale_levels) * global_scale

    # NF2 quantization boundaries
    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2  # -0.7345
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2  # 0.0
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2  # 0.7345

    # Normalize groups by scale
    g_norm = groups / (scale_recon[:, None] / cb_max)

    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)

    # Pack 4 x 2-bit values per byte
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    # Pack scale_q values tightly: scale_bits=6, so pack 4 per 3 bytes
    # Actually store as uint8 for simplicity — zlib will compress repeated patterns
    # But to be more aggressive: pack 6-bit values into bytes
    # 4 six-bit values fit in 3 bytes
    nsc = scale_q.size
    pad_sc = (4 - (nsc % 4)) % 4
    if pad_sc > 0:
        sq_pad = np.concatenate([scale_q, np.zeros(pad_sc, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        sq_pad = scale_q.copy()

    sq_pad = sq_pad.astype(np.uint8) & 0x3F  # ensure 6 bits
    num_sc_chunks = sq_pad.size // 4
    sc_chunks = sq_pad.reshape(num_sc_chunks, 4)

import numpy as np
import math

KNOBS = {
    "bits": 2,
    "group_size": 16,
    "codebook_type": 1,  # 1 = NF4-style normal quantile codebook
}

def compress_tensor(w, bits=2, group_size=16, codebook_type=1):
    """
    2-bit NF2 (normal-float) group quantization with group_size=16.
    Smaller groups = better reconstruction quality per bit.
    Scales stored as float16.
    Pack 4 values per byte.
    
    Key insight: group_size=16 vs 32 gives better per-group approximation,
    but the scale overhead is 2x. At 2-bit with group_size=16:
    - data bits: 2 bits/weight = 0.25 bytes/weight
    - scale: 2 bytes per 16 weights = 0.125 bytes/weight
    - total raw: ~0.375 bytes/weight before zlib
    
    zlib will compress well because indices are low-entropy (only 4 symbols).
    """
    # NF2 codebook: quantiles of N(0,1) at 1/8, 3/8, 5/8, 7/8
    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    x = w.reshape(-1).astype(np.float32)
    n = x.size

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    if pad > 0:
        x_pad = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros(pad, dtype=np.float32)])
    else:
        x_pad = x

    num_groups = x_pad.size // group_size
    groups = x_pad.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    # Per-group scale aligned to codebook max
    amax = np.max(np.abs(groups), axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    amax = np.where(amax == 0, np.float32(1.0), amax)
    cb_max = float(CB[-1])
    scale = (amax / cb_max).astype(np.float16)
    scale_f32 = scale.astype(np.float32)[:, None]

    # Quantize: nearest codebook entry
    b1 = (CB[0] + CB[1]) / 2  # ~ -0.7345
    b2 = (CB[1] + CB[2]) / 2  # ~ 0.0
    b3 = (CB[2] + CB[3]) / 2  # ~ 0.7345

    g_norm = groups / scale_f32

    q = np.where(g_norm < b1, np.uint8(0),
        np.where(g_norm < b2, np.uint8(1),
        np.where(g_norm < b3, np.uint8(2),
                               np.uint8(3))))

    flat_q = q.reshape(-1)

    # Pack 4 x 2-bit values per byte
    total_vals = flat_q.size
    pad4 = (4 - (total_vals % 4)) % 4
    if pad4 > 0:
        flat_q_p = np.concatenate([flat_q, np.zeros(pad4, dtype=np.uint8)])
    else:
        flat_q_p = flat_q

    num_bytes = flat_q_p.size // 4
    chunks = flat_q_p.reshape(num_bytes, 4)
    packed = ((chunks[:, 0] & 0x3)
            | ((chunks[:, 1] & 0x3) << 2)
            | ((chunks[:, 2] & 0x3) << 4)
            | ((chunks[:, 3] & 0x3) << 6)).astype(np.uint8)

    return {
        "packed": packed,
        "scale": scale,
        "n": np.int32(n),
        "group_size": np.int32(group_size),
        "codebook_type": np.int32(codebook_type),
    }


def reconstruct_tensor(payload, shape):
    packed = payload["packed"]
    scale = payload["scale"].astype(np.float32)
    n = int(payload["n"])
    group_size = int(payload["group_size"])
    codebook_type = int(payload["codebook_type"])

    if codebook_type == 1:
        CB = np.array([-1.1503, -0.3186, 0.3186, 1.1503], dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        CB = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5], dtype=np.float32)

    b = packed.astype(np.uint8)
    v0 = (b & 0x3)
    v1 = (b >> 2) & 0x3
    v2 = (b >> 4) & 0x3
    v3 = (b >> 6) & 0x3
    flat_q = np.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3], axis=1).reshape(-1)

    pad = (group_size - (n % group_size)) % group_size
    total = n + pad
    num_groups = total // group_size

    flat_q = flat_q[:total].astype(np.int32)
    groups_q = flat_q.reshape(num_groups, group_size)

    decoded = CB[groups_q] * scale[:, None]

    flat_r = decoded.reshape(-1)[:n]
    return flat_r.reshape(shape).astype(np.float32)
